item.title: Iranian Vessel Hit in Hormuz as Houthis Expand Control of Shipping Lane
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthis expanded their control over the strategic Bab-el-Mandeb strait, as strikes continued in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Deputies Respond to Trespasser at Malibu Home of Kamala Harris
item.description: A trespasser was reported at former Vice President Kamala Harris' Malibu, California, home.

item.title: Search Underway for 140 People After Indonesian Passenger Ship Overturns
item.description: Indonesian rescuers launched a search operation after authorities lost contact with a passenger ship carrying more than 240 people in the Java Sea.

item.title: President Trump's Childhood Home Sells for $2 Million
item.description: A renovation transformed it from a mold-ridden cat den to a modern abode.
